text: 随着2026年A股三季报披露收官，中国国新与中国诚通两大国有资本运营平台三季度持仓动向浮出水面。中国国新旗下国新投资以及中国诚通控股集团有限公司，在电力、能源、军工电子、通信、半导体等多个重点赛道，展开新进布局与增持动作。
text_en: As the disclosure of 2026 third-quarter reports by A-share companies concluded, the third-quarter holdings of China Reform and China Chengtong, the two major state-owned capital operation platforms, came to light. China Reform Investment under China Reform and China Chengtong Holdings Group made new entries and increased holdings across key sectors including power, energy, military electronics, telecommunications and semiconductors.
